name: giant-armor
description: Development, session and assistant-operations workflows in one plugin: git, PRs, tickets, releases, Python testing, run-and-verify, session tooling, and skill improvement.

interface.longDescription: One plugin for development work: conventional commits, PR creation and feedback, tickets, releases, HTML diff reports, spec interviews and contradiction checks, Python test-first workflows with pytest planning, review and audit, Celery and Redis references, running and verifying apps through their real runtime surface, daily notes, interviews, team design, task management and handoffs, and assistant operations: AGENTS.md audits, skill improvement, harness adaptation, overlap audits, insight capture and Markdown bloat trimming.
defaultPrompt: Create a conventional commit for these changes.
Plan and write appropriate tests for this endpoint.
Verify this change in the running app.
Create a handoff for the next session.
Improve this skill from eval feedback.
